resources.string: Read supported codes locally with explicit camera access.
Permission response received. Tap Start again if camera access is allowed.

Destination host: %1$s

%2$s

Opening sends this URL to another app and may contact the site. Code contents are untrusted; check the full address.
No app could open this link.

Supports QR, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417, Code 128/39, EAN-13/8, UPC-A/E and ITF. Recognition depends on camera, lighting and code quality. A result stops the camera. Code text is untrusted: nothing is opened, called, downloaded or configured automatically.

Frames are bounded and decoded locally, then discarded. No files, network decoding, History, Workbench or saved results. Stop, backgrounding or leaving clears the result; permission grants never start capture. Copy and sharing require explicit actions.
Start explicitly, grant camera permission if needed, then Start again. Review decoded text before copying, sharing or opening an eligible HTTP(S) link.
Scan a non-private printed QR code and inspect its text without opening it.
Not all codes or damaged images are readable. Results are untrusted and limited to 4,096 characters; oversized content is rejected rather than truncated.
